nonBlockingObservations.title: Make the supersession and downstream file list exhaustive
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The operative choice and conditional implementation obligations are clear, but section 9 is not a complete locator for every displaced formula or downstream file. C1a/PLAN-r6.md:165 still states the former linear-program bound within the old object/edge caps; the historical changes table at :51 also repeats it. Section 9 lists several displaced r6 passages but omits these. It also mentions that work_ledger.rs has no snapshot profile rather than explicitly listing its forthcoming constructor/constants change, and does not enumerate the refreshed discovery_census.json and receipt artifacts required by the retained C1a4 protocol.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: Add the old formal-bound passage to the supersession locators (mark repeated change-table text as history), and explicitly distinguish changed/new implementation files, regenerated census/vector artifacts, and discovery/snapshot receipts. This is documentation completeness: sections 5-6 and the retained r6 gate already make the intended rule and validation obligations unambiguous.
